data.title: Unit 8: Force, tools, and machines
Types of force
data.heading: Air resistance
data.text: Air resistance is a type of friction. Instead of one object rubbing against another to slow it down, air slows down the object.
Parachutes work because of air resistance.
A parachutist falls slowly because the air pushes against the parachute.
That air resistance slows down the falling parachute.
